                 if d['region'] == region and d['setting'] == 'Urban')
    rural = next(d['penetration'] for d in ur_data
                 if d['region'] == region and d['setting'] == 'Rural')
    gap = urban - rural

    # Connecting line
    ax.plot([rural, urban], [y_positions[i], y_positions[i]],
            color=COLORS[region], linewidth=2.8, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=2)

    # Filled dot = Urban, hollow dot = Rural
    ax.scatter(urban, y_positions[i], s=80, color=COLORS[region], zorder=4,
               edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8)
    ax.scatter(rural, y_positions[i], s=80, color='white', zorder=4,
               edgecolors=COLORS[region], linewidths=2.2)

    # Gap annotation on the line
    ax.annotate(f'{gap} pp', ((urban + rural) / 2, y_positions[i] + 0.28),
                fontsize=8, ha='center', va='bottom', color='#333333',
                fontweight='bold', fontstyle='italic')

    # Value labels on the dots
    ax.annotate(f'{rural}%', (rural, y_positions[i]),
                textcoords="offset points", xytext=(-24, 0),
                fontsize=8, color=COLORS[region], ha='right', va='center', fontweight='bold')
    ax.annotate(f'{urban}%', (urban, y_positions[i]),
                textcoords="offset points", xytext=(24, 0),
                fontsize=8, color=COLORS[region], ha='left', va='center', fontweight='bold')

ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels(REGION_ORDER, fontsize=9)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0, pad=8)

ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['left'].set_color('#AAAAAA')
ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#AAAAAA')

ax.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')
ax.set_title('Urban–Rural Divide', fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10, color='#222222')

# Dot-type legend
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#555555',
           markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5, markersize=9, label='Urban'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='white',
           markeredgecolor='#555555', markeredgewidth=2.2, markersize=9, label='Rural'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower right', fontsize=7.5,
          frameon=True, framealpha=0.7, edgecolor='#DDDDDD',
          handletextpad=0.6, borderpad=0.4, labelspacing=0.3)

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PANEL D: Regional Overview
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax = axes[1, 1]
add_shaded_band(ax)

regions_list = [d['region'] for d in region_data]
overall_pct = [d['overall_penetration'] for d in region_data]
pop = [d['population_millions'] for d in region_data]
users = [d['internet_users_millions'] for d in region_data]

y_pos = np.arange(len(regions_list))[::-1]  # reversed so top region is at top

for i, (region, yp) in enumerate(zip(regions_list, y_pos)):
    pct = overall_pct[i]
    # Full-width background bar
    ax.barh(yp, 100, height=0.5, color='#ECECEC', zorder=1)
    # Actual penetration
    ax.barh(yp, pct, height=0.5, color=COLORS[region], zorder=2, alpha=0.92)
    # Label inside or outside bar
    if pct > 50:
        ax.annotate(f'{pct}%', (pct - 4, yp), textcoords="data",
                    fontsize=11, color='white', ha='right', va='center', fontweight='bold')
    else:
        ax.annotate(f'{pct}%', (pct + 4, yp), textcoords="data",
                    fontsize=11, color=COLORS[region], ha='left', va='center', fontweight='bold')
    # Population context
    ax.annotate(f'{pop[i]:,}M people  ·  {users[i]:,}M online',

                fontsize=7.2, color='#888888', ha='left', va='center')

global_avg = np.mean(overall_pct)
ax.axvline(global_avg, color='#999999', linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--', zorder=5)
ax.annotate(f'Global avg: {global_avg:.0f}%', (global_avg + 0.5, y_pos[0] + 0.55),
            fontsize=7, color='#777777', ha='left', va='bottom', fontstyle='italic')

ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax.set_yticklabels(regions_list, fontsize=9)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0, pad=8)
ax.set_xlim(0, 140)
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(20))
ax.grid(axis='x', color='#D8D8D8', linewidth=0.4)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#AAAAAA')

ax.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')
ax.set_title('Regional Overview', fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=10, color='#222222')

             fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', x=0.09, ha='left', y=0.97, color='#111111')
fig.text(0.09, 0.935, 'Internet penetration by income, age, urban–rural setting, and region · 2023 estimates',

         fontsize=6.5, color='#AAAAAA', ha='left')

panel_labels = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']
for idx, ax in enumerate(axes.flatten()):
    ax.text(-0.06, 1.03, panel_labels[idx], transform=ax.transAxes,

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import json

# ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

income_data = data['internet_by_income_quintile']['data']
age_data = data['internet_by_age_group']['data']
ur_data = data['internet_by_urban_rural']['data']
region_data = data['internet_overall_by_region']['data']

# ── Style ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman', 'serif'],
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 9.5,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8.5,
    'legend.fontsize': 8,
    'figure.dpi': 200,
    'savefig.dpi': 200,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.2,
})

# Stark editorial palette
COLORS = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': '#C44E52',
    'South Asia': '#E69F3C',
    'Europe': '#4C72B0',
    'North America': '#2C3E50',
}

REGION_ORDER = ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia', 'Europe', 'North America']
DEVELOPING = {'Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia'}
DEVELOPED = {'Europe', 'North America'}

QUINTILE_LABELS = ['Q1\n(Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5\n(Highest)']
AGE_LABELS = ['15–24', '25–34', '35–44', '45–54', '55–64', '65+']

# ── Create figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 10))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, hspace=0.52, wspace=0.28,
                      top=0.875, bottom=0.08, left=0.10, right=0.96)

ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_d = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
axes = [ax_a, ax_b, ax_c, ax_d]

# ── Common styling ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def style_xy_ax(ax):
    ax.set_ylim(0, 108)
    ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(20))
    ax.grid(axis='y', color='#D8D8D8', linewidth=0.4)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for spine in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)
    for spine in ['left', 'bottom']:
        ax.spines[spine].set_color('#AAAAAA')
    ax.tick_params(colors='#555555', length=3, pad=3)
    ax.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')

def style_horz_ax(ax):
    ax.set_xlim(0, 108)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(20))
    ax.grid(axis='x', color='#D8D8D8', linewidth=0.4)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for spine in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)
    for spine in ['left', 'bottom']:
        ax.spines[spine].set_color('#AAAAAA')
    ax.tick_params(colors='#555555', length=3, pad=3)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A: Income Quintile Divide
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_a

# Draw a soft background band 0-100
ax.axhspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)

for region in REGION_ORDER:
    pts = sorted([d for d in income_data if d['region'] == region],
                 key=lambda x: int(x['quintile'][1]))
    x = np.arange(5)
    y = np.array([p['penetration'] for p in pts])

    # Main line
    ax.plot(x, y, '-o', color=COLORS[region], linewidth=2.2, markersize=6.5,
            markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.8,
            markeredgecolor=COLORS[region], clip_on=False, zorder=4)

    # Endpoint value labels
    offset_right = 16 if region in DEVELOPED else 16
    offset_left = -16
    # Q1 label
    ax.annotate(f'{y[0]}%', (x[0], y[0]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(offset_left, 0), fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region],
                ha='right', va='center', fontweight='bold')
    # Q5 label
    ax.annotate(f'{y[-1]}%', (x[-1], y[-1]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(offset_right, 0), fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region],
                ha='left', va='center', fontweight='bold')

    # Gap annotation on the right side of panel
    gap = y[-1] - y[0]
    # Position gap note at the Q5 y-level but out in the margin area
    ax.annotate(f'Δ {gap} pp', (4.75, (y[0] + y[-1]) / 2),
                fontsize=7.2, ha='left', va='center',
                color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold', alpha=0.85,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',
                          edgecolor=COLORS[region], linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.85))

style_xy_ax(ax)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(5))
ax.set_xticklabels(QUINTILE_LABELS, linespacing=1.2)
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, 5.2)  # extra margin for gap labels

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PANEL B: Age Group Divide
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax = ax_b
ax.axhspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)
age_order = ['15-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55-64', '65+']

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import json

# ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

income_data = data['internet_by_income_quintile']['data']
age_data = data['internet_by_age_group']['data']
ur_data = data['internet_by_urban_rural']['data']
region_data = data['internet_overall_by_region']['data']

# ── Style ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman', 'serif'],
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 9.5,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8.5,
    'legend.fontsize': 8,
    'figure.dpi': 200,
    'savefig.dpi': 200,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.2,
})

# Stark editorial palette
COLORS = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': '#C44E52',
    'South Asia': '#E69F3C',
    'Europe': '#4C72B0',
    'North America': '#2C3E50',
}

REGION_ORDER = ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia', 'Europe', 'North America']
DEVELOPING = {'Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia'}
DEVELOPED = {'Europe', 'North America'}

QUINTILE_LABELS = ['Q1\n(Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5\n(Highest)']
AGE_LABELS = ['15–24', '25–34', '35–44', '45–54', '55–64', '65+']

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import json

# ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

income_data = data['internet_by_income_quintile']['data']
age_data = data['internet_by_age_group']['data']
ur_data = data['internet_by_urban_rural']['data']
region_data = data['internet_overall_by_region']['data']

# ── Style ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman', 'serif'],
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 9.5,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8.5,
    'legend.fontsize': 8,
    'figure.dpi': 200,
    'savefig.dpi': 200,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.2,
})

# Stark editorial palette — warm (developing) vs cool (developed)
COLORS = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': '#C44E52',
    'South Asia': '#E69F3C',
    'Europe': '#4C72B0',
    'North America': '#2C3E50',
}

REGION_ORDER = ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia', 'Europe', 'North America']
DEVELOPING = {'Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia'}
DEVELOPED = {'Europe', 'North America'}

QUINTILE_LABELS = ['Q1\n(Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5\n(Highest)']
AGE_LABELS = ['15–24', '25–34', '35–44', '45–54', '55–64', '65+']

# ── Create figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 10.2))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, hspace=0.50, wspace=0.28,
                      top=0.865, bottom=0.08, left=0.10, right=0.96)

ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_d = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
axes = [ax_a, ax_b, ax_c, ax_d]

# ── Common styling helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
def style_xy_ax(ax, ylabel=True):
    ax.set_ylim(0, 108)
    ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(20))
    ax.grid(axis='y', color='#D8D8D8', linewidth=0.4)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for sp in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
    for sp in ['left', 'bottom']:
        ax.spines[sp].set_color('#AAAAAA')
    ax.tick_params(colors='#555555', length=3, pad=3)
    if ylabel:
        ax.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')

def style_horz_ax(ax):
    ax.set_xlim(0, 115)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(20))
    ax.grid(axis='x', color='#D8D8D8', linewidth=0.4)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for sp in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
    for sp in ['left', 'bottom']:
        ax.spines[sp].set_color('#AAAAAA')
    ax.tick_params(colors='#555555', length=3, pad=3)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A: Income Quintile Divide
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_a
ax.axhspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)

for idx, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    pts = sorted([d for d in income_data if d['region'] == region],
                 key=lambda x: int(x['quintile'][1]))
    x = np.arange(5)
    y = np.array([p['penetration'] for p in pts])

    ax.plot(x, y, '-o', color=COLORS[region], linewidth=2.2, markersize=6.5,
            markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.8,
            markeredgecolor=COLORS[region], clip_on=False, zorder=4)

    # Endpoint values
    ax.annotate(f'{y[0]}%', (x[0], y[0]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(-16, 0), fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region],
                ha='right', va='center', fontweight='bold')
    ax.annotate(f'{y[-1]}%', (x[-1], y[-1]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(16, 0), fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region],
                ha='left', va='center', fontweight='bold')

    # Gap annotation — stagger x-positions horizontally to avoid overlap
    gap = y[-1] - y[0]
    # Use different x-offsets per region to prevent label collision
    x_offsets = [4.35, 4.55, 4.75, 4.95]
    # For EU/NA (close midpoints at ~85), offset vertically too
    midpoint = (y[0] + y[-1]) / 2
    if region == 'Europe':
        midpoint += 5.5  # push up
    elif region == 'North America':
        midpoint -= 5.5  # push down

    ax.annotate(f'Δ {gap} pp', (x_offsets[idx], midpoint),
                fontsize=7.2, ha='left', va='center',
                color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',
                          edgecolor=COLORS[region], linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.88))

style_xy_ax(ax)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(5))
ax.set_xticklabels(QUINTILE_LABELS, linespacing=1.2)
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, 5.6)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B: Age Group Divide
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_b
ax.axhspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)
age_order = ['15-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55-64', '65+']

for idx, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    pts = sorted([d for d in age_data if d['region'] == region],
                 key=lambda x: age_order.index(x['age_group']))
    x = np.arange(6)
    y = np.array([p['penetration'] for p in pts])

    ax.plot(x, y, '-o', color=COLORS[region], linewidth=2.2, markersize=6.5,
            markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.8,
            markeredgecolor=COLORS[region], clip_on=False, zorder=4)

    # Endpoint values
    ax.annotate(f'{y[0]}%', (x[0], y[0]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(-16, 0), fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region],
                ha='right', va='center', fontweight='bold')
    ax.annotate(f'{y[-1]}%', (x[-1], y[-1]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(16, 0), fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region],
                ha='left', va='center', fontweight='bold')

    # Gap annotation — staggered
    gap = y[0] - y[-1]
    x_offsets = [5.35, 5.55, 5.75, 5.95]
    midpoint = (y[0] + y[-1]) / 2
    if region == 'Europe':
        midpoint += 5.5
    elif region == 'North America':
        midpoint -= 5.5

    ax.annotate(f'Δ {gap} pp', (x_offsets[idx], midpoint),
                fontsize=7.2, ha='left', va='center',
                color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',
                          edgecolor=COLORS[region], linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.88))

style_xy_ax(ax)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(6))
ax.set_xticklabels(AGE_LABELS)
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, 6.6)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL C: Urban–Rural Divide (dumbbell chart)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_c
ax.axvspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)  # shaded data region

y_positions = [0, 1, 2, 3]

for i, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    urban = next(d['penetration'] for d in ur_data
                 if d['region'] == region and d['setting'] == 'Urban')
    rural = next(d['penetration'] for d in ur_data
                 if d['region'] == region and d['setting'] == 'Rural')
    gap = urban - rural

    # Dumbbell bar
    ax.plot([rural, urban], [y_positions[i], y_positions[i]],
            color=COLORS[region], linewidth=3.0, solid_capstyle='round',
            zorder=2, alpha=0.85)

    # Filled = Urban, Hollow with thick border = Rural
    ax.scatter(urban, y_positions[i], s=90, color=COLORS[region], zorder=4,
               edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8)
    ax.scatter(rural, y_positions[i], s=90, color='white', zorder=4,
               edgecolors=COLORS[region], linewidths=2.5)

    # Gap size label on the connecting line
    ax.annotate(f'{gap} pp', ((urban + rural) / 2, y_positions[i] + 0.30),
                fontsize=8.5, ha='center', va='bottom', color='#333333',
                fontweight='bold', fontstyle='italic')

    # Value labels beside each dot
    ax.annotate(f'{rural}%', (rural, y_positions[i]),
                textcoords="offset points", xytext=(-26, 0),
                fontsize=8.5, color=COLORS[region], ha='right', va='center',
                fontweight='bold')
    ax.annotate(f'{urban}%', (urban, y_positions[i]),
                textcoords="offset points", xytext=(26, 0),
                fontsize=8.5, color=COLORS[region], ha='left', va='center',
                fontweight='bold')

ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels(REGION_ORDER, fontsize=9.5)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0, pad=10)
ax.set_ylim(-0.6, 3.6)

style_horz_ax(ax)
ax.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')

# Dot legend
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_el = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#555555',
           markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5, markersize=10,
           label='Urban'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='white',
           markeredgecolor='#555555', markeredgewidth=2.5, markersize=10,
           label='Rural'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_el, loc='lower right', fontsize=8,
          frameon=True, framealpha=0.75, edgecolor='#DDDDDD',
          handletextpad=0.6, borderpad=0.5, labelspacing=0.4)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL D: Regional Overview (horizontal bars)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_d
ax.axvspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)

# Keep data ordering from source
regions_list = [d['region'] for d in region_data]
overall_pct = [d['overall_penetration'] for d in region_data]
pop_m = [d['population_millions'] for d in region_data]
users_m = [d['internet_users_millions'] for d in region_data]

y_pos_d = np.arange(len(regions_list))[::-1]  # top-to-bottom = first-to-last

for i, (region, yp) in enumerate(zip(regions_list, y_pos_d)):
    pct = overall_pct[i]
    # Reference bar (100%)
    ax.barh(yp, 100, height=0.52, color='#EDEDED', zorder=1)
    # Data bar
    ax.barh(yp, pct, height=0.52, color=COLORS[region], zorder=2, alpha=0.93)
    # Label
    if pct >= 55:
        ax.annotate(f'{pct}%', (pct - 3, yp), textcoords="data",
                    fontsize=12, color='white', ha='right', va='center',
                    fontweight='bold')
    else:
        ax.annotate(f'{pct}%', (pct + 3, yp), textcoords="data",
                    fontsize=12, color=COLORS[region], ha='left', va='center',
                    fontweight='bold')
    # Population context
    ax.annotate(f'{pop_m[i]:,}M people\n{users_m[i]:,}M internet users',
                (104, yp), textcoords="data",
                fontsize=7.5, color='#999999', ha='left', va='center',
                linespacing=1.4)

# Global average reference
global_avg = np.mean(overall_pct)
ax.axvline(global_avg, color='#999999', linewidth=0.9, linestyle='--',
           zorder=5, alpha=0.8)

ax.set_yticks(y_pos_d)
ax.set_yticklabels(regions_list, fontsize=9.5)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0, pad=10)
ax.set_ylim(-0.6, 3.6)

style_horz_ax(ax)
ax.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')

# ── Figure title ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.suptitle('The Four Dimensions of the Digital Divide',
             fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', x=0.10, ha='left', y=0.975,
             color='#111111')
fig.text(0.10, 0.937, 'Internet penetration inequality across income, age, urban–rural, and geographic dimensions · 2023 estimates',
         fontsize=9, color='#666666', ha='left', fontstyle='italic')

# Source line
fig.text(0.10, 0.016,
         'Sources: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research Center · Penetration defined as share of individuals who used the internet in the past 3 months · Income quintiles based on national household income distributions',
         fontsize=6.5, color='#BBBBBB', ha='left')

# ── Shared region legend ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_handles = []
for region in REGION_ORDER:
    legend_handles.append(
        plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=COLORS[region], marker='o', markersize=6.5,
                    linewidth=2, label=region, markerfacecolor='white',
                    markeredgewidth=1.8, markeredgecolor=COLORS[region])
    )
leg = fig.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='upper right',
                 bbox_to_anchor=(0.96, 0.975), frameon=True, framealpha=0.85,
                 edgecolor='#DDDDDD', ncol=2, handletextpad=0.5, borderpad=0.5,
                 columnspacing=0.7, fontsize=8)

# ── Panel labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
titles = ['Income Quintile Divide', 'Age Group Divide',
          'Urban–Rural Divide', 'Regional Overview']
letters = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']

for ax, letter, title in zip(axes, letters, titles):
    ax.text(0.0, 1.055, f'{letter}  {title}', transform=ax.transAxes,
            fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', ha='left', va='bottom',
            color='#222222')

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')

    # For EU/NA (close midpoints at ~85), offset vertically too
    midpoint = (y[0] + y[-1]) / 2
    if region == 'Europe':
        midpoint += 5.5  # push up
    elif region == 'North America':
        midpoint -= 5.5  # push down

    ax.annotate(f'Δ {gap} pp', (x_offsets[idx], midpoint),
                fontsize=7.2, ha='left', va='center',
                color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',
                          edgecolor=COLORS[region], linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.88))

style_xy_ax(ax)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(5))
ax.set_xticklabels(QUINTILE_LABELS, linespacing=1.2)
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, 5.6)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B: Age Group Divide
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_b
ax.axhspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)
age_order = ['15-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55-64', '65+']

for idx, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    pts = sorted([d for d in age_data if d['region'] == region],
                 key=lambda x: age_order.index(x['age_group']))
    x = np.arange(6)
    y = np.array([p['penetration'] for p in pts])

    ax.plot(x, y, '-o', color=COLORS[region], linewidth=2.2, markersize=6.5,
            markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.8,
            markeredgecolor=COLORS[region], clip_on=False, zorder=4)

    # Endpoint values
    ax.annotate(f'{y[0]}%', (x[0], y[0]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(-16, 0), fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region],
                ha='right', va='center', fontweight='bold')
    ax.annotate(f'{y[-1]}%', (x[-1], y[-1]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(16, 0), fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region],
                ha='left', va='center', fontweight='bold')

    # Gap annotation — staggered
    gap = y[0] - y[-1]
    x_offsets = [5.35, 5.55, 5.75, 5.95]
    midpoint = (y[0] + y[-1]) / 2
    if region == 'Europe':
        midpoint += 5.5
    elif region == 'North America':
        midpoint -= 5.5

    ax.annotate(f'Δ {gap} pp', (x_offsets[idx], midpoint),
                fontsize=7.2, ha='left', va='center',
                color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',
                          edgecolor=COLORS[region], linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.88))

style_xy_ax(ax)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(6))
ax.set_xticklabels(AGE_LABELS)
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, 6.6)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL C: Urban–Rural Divide (dumbbell chart)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_c
ax.axvspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)  # shaded data region

y_positions = [0, 1, 2, 3]

for i, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    urban = next(d['penetration'] for d in ur_data
                 if d['region'] == region and d['setting'] == 'Urban')
    rural = next(d['penetration'] for d in ur_data
                 if d['region'] == region and d['setting'] == 'Rural')
    gap = urban - rural

    # Dumbbell bar
    ax.plot([rural, urban], [y_positions[i], y_positions[i]],
            color=COLORS[region], linewidth=3.0, solid_capstyle='round',
            zorder=2, alpha=0.85)

    # Filled = Urban, Hollow with thick border = Rural
    ax.scatter(urban, y_positions[i], s=90, color=COLORS[region], zorder=4,
               edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8)
    ax.scatter(rural, y_positions[i], s=90, color='white', zorder=4,
               edgecolors=COLORS[region], linewidths=2.5)

    # Gap size label on the connecting line
    ax.annotate(f'{gap} pp', ((urban + rural) / 2, y_positions[i] + 0.30),
                fontsize=8.5, ha='center', va='bottom', color='#333333',
                fontweight='bold', fontstyle='italic')

    # Value labels beside each dot
    ax.annotate(f'{rural}%', (rural, y_positions[i]),
                textcoords="offset points", xytext=(-26, 0),
                fontsize=8.5, color=COLORS[region], ha='right', va='center',
                fontweight='bold')
    ax.annotate(f'{urban}%', (urban, y_positions[i]),
                textcoords="offset points", xytext=(26, 0),
                fontsize=8.5, color=COLORS[region], ha='left', va='center',
                fontweight='bold')

ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels(REGION_ORDER, fontsize=9.5)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0, pad=10)
ax.set_ylim(-0.6, 3.6)

style_horz_ax(ax)
ax.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')

# Dot legend
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_el = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#555555',
           markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5, markersize=10,
           label='Urban'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='white',
           markeredgecolor='#555555', markeredgewidth=2.5, markersize=10,
           label='Rural'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_el, loc='lower right', fontsize=8,
          frameon=True, framealpha=0.75, edgecolor='#DDDDDD',
          handletextpad=0.6, borderpad=0.5, labelspacing=0.4)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL D: Regional Overview (horizontal bars)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_d
ax.axvspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)

# Keep data ordering from source
regions_list = [d['region'] for d in region_data]
overall_pct = [d['overall_penetration'] for d in region_data]
pop_m = [d['population_millions'] for d in region_data]
users_m = [d['internet_users_millions'] for d in region_data]

y_pos_d = np.arange(len(regions_list))[::-1]  # top-to-bottom = first-to-last

for i, (region, yp) in enumerate(zip(regions_list, y_pos_d)):
    pct = overall_pct[i]
    # Reference bar (100%)
    ax.barh(yp, 100, height=0.52, color='#EDEDED', zorder=1)
    # Data bar
    ax.barh(yp, pct, height=0.52, color=COLORS[region], zorder=2, alpha=0.93)
    # Label
    if pct >= 55:
        ax.annotate(f'{pct}%', (pct - 3, yp), textcoords="data",
                    fontsize=12, color='white', ha='right', va='center',
                    fontweight='bold')
    else:
        ax.annotate(f'{pct}%', (pct + 3, yp), textcoords="data",
                    fontsize=12, color=COLORS[region], ha='left', va='center',
                    fontweight='bold')
    # Population context
    ax.annotate(f'{pop_m[i]:,}M people\n{users_m[i]:,}M internet users',
                (104, yp), textcoords="data",
                fontsize=7.5, color='#999999', ha='left', va='center',
                linespacing=1.4)

# Global average reference
global_avg = np.mean(overall_pct)
ax.axvline(global_avg, color='#999999', linewidth=0.9, linestyle='--',
           zorder=5, alpha=0.8)

ax.set_yticks(y_pos_d)
ax.set_yticklabels(regions_list, fontsize=9.5)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0, pad=10)
ax.set_ylim(-0.6, 3.6)

style_horz_ax(ax)
ax.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')

fig.text(0.10, 0.937, 'Internet penetration inequality across income, age, urban–rural, and geographic dimensions · 2023 estimates',

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import json

# ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

income_data = data['internet_by_income_quintile']['data']
age_data = data['internet_by_age_group']['data']
ur_data = data['internet_by_urban_rural']['data']
region_data = data['internet_overall_by_region']['data']

# ── Style ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman', 'serif'],
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.titlesize': 11,
    'axes.labelsize': 9.5,
    'xtick.labelsize': 8.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 8.5,
    'legend.fontsize': 8,
    'figure.dpi': 200,
    'savefig.dpi': 200,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.2,
})

# Stark editorial palette — warm (developing) vs cool (developed)
COLORS = {
    'Sub-Saharan Africa': '#C44E52',
    'South Asia': '#E69F3C',
    'Europe': '#4C72B0',
    'North America': '#2C3E50',
}

REGION_ORDER = ['Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia', 'Europe', 'North America']
DEVELOPING = {'Sub-Saharan Africa', 'South Asia'}
DEVELOPED = {'Europe', 'North America'}

QUINTILE_LABELS = ['Q1\n(Lowest)', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'Q5\n(Highest)']
AGE_LABELS = ['15–24', '25–34', '35–44', '45–54', '55–64', '65+']

# ── Create figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 10.2))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, hspace=0.50, wspace=0.28,
                      top=0.865, bottom=0.08, left=0.10, right=0.96)

ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_d = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
axes = [ax_a, ax_b, ax_c, ax_d]

# ── Common styling helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
def style_xy_ax(ax, ylabel=True):
    ax.set_ylim(0, 108)
    ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(20))
    ax.grid(axis='y', color='#D8D8D8', linewidth=0.4)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for sp in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
    for sp in ['left', 'bottom']:
        ax.spines[sp].set_color('#AAAAAA')
    ax.tick_params(colors='#555555', length=3, pad=3)
    if ylabel:
        ax.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')

def style_horz_ax(ax):
    ax.set_xlim(0, 115)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(20))
    ax.grid(axis='x', color='#D8D8D8', linewidth=0.4)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for sp in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
    for sp in ['left', 'bottom']:
        ax.spines[sp].set_color('#AAAAAA')
    ax.tick_params(colors='#555555', length=3, pad=3)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A: Income Quintile Divide
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_a
ax.axhspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)

for idx, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    pts = sorted([d for d in income_data if d['region'] == region],
                 key=lambda x: int(x['quintile'][1]))
    x = np.arange(5)
    y = np.array([p['penetration'] for p in pts])

    ax.plot(x, y, '-o', color=COLORS[region], linewidth=2.2, markersize=6.5,
            markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.8,
            markeredgecolor=COLORS[region], clip_on=False, zorder=4)

    # Endpoint values
    ax.annotate(f'{y[0]}%', (x[0], y[0]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(-16, 0), fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region],
                ha='right', va='center', fontweight='bold')
    ax.annotate(f'{y[-1]}%', (x[-1], y[-1]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(16, 0), fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region],
                ha='left', va='center', fontweight='bold')

    # Gap annotation — stagger x-positions horizontally to avoid overlap
    gap = y[-1] - y[0]
    # Use different x-offsets per region to prevent label collision
    x_offsets = [4.35, 4.55, 4.75, 4.95]
    # For EU/NA (close midpoints at ~85), offset vertically too
    midpoint = (y[0] + y[-1]) / 2
    if region == 'Europe':
        midpoint += 5.5  # push up
    elif region == 'North America':
        midpoint -= 5.5  # push down

    ax.annotate(f'Δ {gap} pp', (x_offsets[idx], midpoint),
                fontsize=7.2, ha='left', va='center',
                color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',
                          edgecolor=COLORS[region], linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.88))

style_xy_ax(ax)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(5))
ax.set_xticklabels(QUINTILE_LABELS, linespacing=1.2)
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, 5.6)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B: Age Group Divide
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_b
ax.axhspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)
age_order = ['15-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55-64', '65+']

for idx, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    pts = sorted([d for d in age_data if d['region'] == region],
                 key=lambda x: age_order.index(x['age_group']))
    x = np.arange(6)
    y = np.array([p['penetration'] for p in pts])

    ax.plot(x, y, '-o', color=COLORS[region], linewidth=2.2, markersize=6.5,
            markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.8,
            markeredgecolor=COLORS[region], clip_on=False, zorder=4)

    # Endpoint values
    ax.annotate(f'{y[0]}%', (x[0], y[0]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(-16, 0), fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region],
                ha='right', va='center', fontweight='bold')
    ax.annotate(f'{y[-1]}%', (x[-1], y[-1]), textcoords="offset points",
                xytext=(16, 0), fontsize=7.5, color=COLORS[region],
                ha='left', va='center', fontweight='bold')

    # Gap annotation — staggered
    gap = y[0] - y[-1]
    x_offsets = [5.35, 5.55, 5.75, 5.95]
    midpoint = (y[0] + y[-1]) / 2
    if region == 'Europe':
        midpoint += 5.5
    elif region == 'North America':
        midpoint -= 5.5

    ax.annotate(f'Δ {gap} pp', (x_offsets[idx], midpoint),
                fontsize=7.2, ha='left', va='center',
                color=COLORS[region], fontweight='bold',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', facecolor='white',
                          edgecolor=COLORS[region], linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.88))

style_xy_ax(ax)
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(6))
ax.set_xticklabels(AGE_LABELS)
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, 6.6)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL C: Urban–Rural Divide (dumbbell chart)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_c
ax.axvspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)  # shaded data region

y_positions = [0, 1, 2, 3]

for i, region in enumerate(REGION_ORDER):
    urban = next(d['penetration'] for d in ur_data
                 if d['region'] == region and d['setting'] == 'Urban')
    rural = next(d['penetration'] for d in ur_data
                 if d['region'] == region and d['setting'] == 'Rural')
    gap = urban - rural

    # Dumbbell bar
    ax.plot([rural, urban], [y_positions[i], y_positions[i]],
            color=COLORS[region], linewidth=3.0, solid_capstyle='round',
            zorder=2, alpha=0.85)

    # Filled = Urban, Hollow with thick border = Rural
    ax.scatter(urban, y_positions[i], s=90, color=COLORS[region], zorder=4,
               edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.8)
    ax.scatter(rural, y_positions[i], s=90, color='white', zorder=4,
               edgecolors=COLORS[region], linewidths=2.5)

    # Gap size label on the connecting line
    ax.annotate(f'{gap} pp', ((urban + rural) / 2, y_positions[i] + 0.30),
                fontsize=8.5, ha='center', va='bottom', color='#333333',
                fontweight='bold', fontstyle='italic')

    # Value labels beside each dot
    ax.annotate(f'{rural}%', (rural, y_positions[i]),
                textcoords="offset points", xytext=(-26, 0),
                fontsize=8.5, color=COLORS[region], ha='right', va='center',
                fontweight='bold')
    ax.annotate(f'{urban}%', (urban, y_positions[i]),
                textcoords="offset points", xytext=(26, 0),
                fontsize=8.5, color=COLORS[region], ha='left', va='center',
                fontweight='bold')

ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels(REGION_ORDER, fontsize=9.5)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0, pad=10)
ax.set_ylim(-0.6, 3.6)

style_horz_ax(ax)
ax.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')

# Dot legend
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_el = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#555555',
           markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5, markersize=10,
           label='Urban'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='white',
           markeredgecolor='#555555', markeredgewidth=2.5, markersize=10,
           label='Rural'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_el, loc='lower right', fontsize=8,
          frameon=True, framealpha=0.75, edgecolor='#DDDDDD',
          handletextpad=0.6, borderpad=0.5, labelspacing=0.4)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL D: Regional Overview (horizontal bars)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax = ax_d
ax.axvspan(0, 100, color='#FAFAFA', zorder=0)

# Keep data ordering from source
regions_list = [d['region'] for d in region_data]
overall_pct = [d['overall_penetration'] for d in region_data]
pop_m = [d['population_millions'] for d in region_data]
users_m = [d['internet_users_millions'] for d in region_data]

y_pos_d = np.arange(len(regions_list))[::-1]  # top-to-bottom = first-to-last

for i, (region, yp) in enumerate(zip(regions_list, y_pos_d)):
    pct = overall_pct[i]
    # Reference bar (100%)
    ax.barh(yp, 100, height=0.52, color='#EDEDED', zorder=1)
    # Data bar
    ax.barh(yp, pct, height=0.52, color=COLORS[region], zorder=2, alpha=0.93)
    # Label
    if pct >= 55:
        ax.annotate(f'{pct}%', (pct - 3, yp), textcoords="data",
                    fontsize=12, color='white', ha='right', va='center',
                    fontweight='bold')
    else:
        ax.annotate(f'{pct}%', (pct + 3, yp), textcoords="data",
                    fontsize=12, color=COLORS[region], ha='left', va='center',
                    fontweight='bold')
    # Population context
    ax.annotate(f'{pop_m[i]:,}M people\n{users_m[i]:,}M internet users',
                (104, yp), textcoords="data",
                fontsize=7.5, color='#999999', ha='left', va='center',
                linespacing=1.4)

# Global average reference
global_avg = np.mean(overall_pct)
ax.axvline(global_avg, color='#999999', linewidth=0.9, linestyle='--',
           zorder=5, alpha=0.8)

ax.set_yticks(y_pos_d)
ax.set_yticklabels(regions_list, fontsize=9.5)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0, pad=10)
ax.set_ylim(-0.6, 3.6)

style_horz_ax(ax)
ax.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')

# ── Figure title ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.suptitle('The Four Dimensions of the Digital Divide',
             fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', x=0.10, ha='left', y=0.975,
             color='#111111')
fig.text(0.10, 0.937, 'Internet penetration inequality across income, age, urban–rural, and geographic dimensions · 2023 estimates',
         fontsize=9, color='#666666', ha='left', fontstyle='italic')

# Source line
fig.text(0.10, 0.016,
         'Sources: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research Center · Penetration defined as share of individuals who used the internet in the past 3 months · Income quintiles based on national household income distributions',
         fontsize=6.5, color='#BBBBBB', ha='left')

# ── Shared region legend ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_handles = []
for region in REGION_ORDER:
    legend_handles.append(
        plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=COLORS[region], marker='o', markersize=6.5,
                    linewidth=2, label=region, markerfacecolor='white',
                    markeredgewidth=1.8, markeredgecolor=COLORS[region])
    )
leg = fig.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='upper right',
                 bbox_to_anchor=(0.96, 0.975), frameon=True, framealpha=0.85,
                 edgecolor='#DDDDDD', ncol=2, handletextpad=0.5, borderpad=0.5,
                 columnspacing=0.7, fontsize=8)

# ── Panel labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
titles = ['Income Quintile Divide', 'Age Group Divide',
          'Urban–Rural Divide', 'Regional Overview']
letters = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']

for ax, letter, title in zip(axes, letters, titles):
    ax.text(0.0, 1.055, f'{letter}  {title}', transform=ax.transAxes,
            fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', ha='left', va='bottom',
            color='#222222')

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')

})

# ── Create figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 10.2))
fig.patch.set_facecolor('white')

gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, hspace=0.50, wspace=0.28,
                      top=0.865, bottom=0.08, left=0.10, right=0.96)

ax_a = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
ax_b = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_c = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_d = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])

    ax.set_ylim(0, 108)
    ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MultipleLocator(20))
    ax.grid(axis='y', color='#D8D8D8', linewidth=0.4)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    for sp in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
    for sp in ['left', 'bottom']:
        ax.spines[sp].set_color('#AAAAAA')
    ax.tick_params(colors='#555555', length=3, pad=3)
    if ylabel:
        ax.set_ylabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')

# Keep data ordering from source
regions_list = [d['region'] for d in region_data]
overall_pct = [d['overall_penetration'] for d in region_data]
pop_m = [d['population_millions'] for d in region_data]
users_m = [d['internet_users_millions'] for d in region_data]

y_pos_d = np.arange(len(regions_list))[::-1]  # top-to-bottom = first-to-last

for i, (region, yp) in enumerate(zip(regions_list, y_pos_d)):
    pct = overall_pct[i]
    # Reference bar (100%)
    ax.barh(yp, 100, height=0.52, color='#EDEDED', zorder=1)
    # Data bar
    ax.barh(yp, pct, height=0.52, color=COLORS[region], zorder=2, alpha=0.93)
    # Label
    if pct >= 55:
        ax.annotate(f'{pct}%', (pct - 3, yp), textcoords="data",
                    fontsize=12, color='white', ha='right', va='center',
                    fontweight='bold')
    else:
        ax.annotate(f'{pct}%', (pct + 3, yp), textcoords="data",
                    fontsize=12, color=COLORS[region], ha='left', va='center',
                    fontweight='bold')
    # Population context
    ax.annotate(f'{pop_m[i]:,}M people\n{users_m[i]:,}M internet users',
                (104, yp), textcoords="data",
                fontsize=7.5, color='#999999', ha='left', va='center',
                linespacing=1.4)

# Global average reference
global_avg = np.mean(overall_pct)
ax.axvline(global_avg, color='#999999', linewidth=0.9, linestyle='--',
           zorder=5, alpha=0.8)

ax.set_yticks(y_pos_d)
ax.set_yticklabels(regions_list, fontsize=9.5)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0, pad=10)
ax.set_ylim(-0.6, 3.6)

style_horz_ax(ax)
ax.set_xlabel('Internet Penetration (%)', color='#333333')

# ── Figure title ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.suptitle('The Four Dimensions of the Digital Divide',
             fontsize=15, fontweight='bold', x=0.10, ha='left', y=0.975,
             color='#111111')
fig.text(0.10, 0.937, 'Internet penetration inequality across income, age, urban–rural, and geographic dimensions · 2023 estimates',
         fontsize=9, color='#666666', ha='left', fontstyle='italic')

# Source line
fig.text(0.10, 0.016,
         'Sources: ITU, World Bank, Pew Research Center · Penetration defined as share of individuals who used the internet in the past 3 months · Income quintiles based on national household income distributions',
         fontsize=6.5, color='#BBBBBB', ha='left')

# ── Shared region legend ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_handles = []
for region in REGION_ORDER:
    legend_handles.append(
        plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=COLORS[region], marker='o', markersize=6.5,
                    linewidth=2, label=region, markerfacecolor='white',
                    markeredgewidth=1.8, markeredgecolor=COLORS[region])
    )
leg = fig.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='upper right',
                 bbox_to_anchor=(0.96, 0.975), frameon=True, framealpha=0.85,
                 edgecolor='#DDDDDD', ncol=2, handletextpad=0.5, borderpad=0.5,
                 columnspacing=0.7, fontsize=8)

# ── Panel labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
titles = ['Income Quintile Divide', 'Age Group Divide',
          'Urban–Rural Divide', 'Regional Overview']
letters = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']

for ax, letter, title in zip(axes, letters, titles):
    ax.text(0.0, 1.055, f'{letter}  {title}', transform=ax.transAxes,
            fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', ha='left', va='bottom',
            color='#222222')

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
print('Chart saved to /app/output/result.png')
